definitions.core_principle: A planet in the 8th running its dasa is textbook-negative, but results differ per lagna and placement strength - never conclude negatively from the house alone.

rules.name: Exalted lagna lord in 8th is not 'hidden'
rules.condition: lagna lord in 8th AND exalted (e.g. Jupiter in Kadagam for Dhanusu lagna)
rules.result: Not a concealment or dosha; a strong yoga. Marital-bond (mangalya) strength is good.

rules.name: Ketu with exalted Jupiter in 8th
rules.condition: Ketu conjoined with exalted Jupiter in 8th AND Ketu's dispositor (8th-sign lord) also exalted
rules.result: No harm to Jupiter, Ketu or the marital house.

rules.name: Star-lord 6/8 friction
rules.condition: dasa lord's nakshatra lord is in 6/8 (shashtashtaka) relation with the dasa lord
rules.result: Early part of that dasa (esp. its own bhukti) brings quarrels and ego clashes - not permanent separation.

rules.name: Exalted-planet dasa start can disrupt career
rules.condition: mahadasa of an own-sign/exalted planet begins
rules.result: Career may suffer at the start (job loss possible); little job satisfaction in its own bhukti.
followups: Next bhukti of a planet in Lagna (e.g. Saturn as 2nd lord in Lagna): must take employment, not business; family harmony returns
Bhukti of an own/exalted 10th lord sitting in an exalted planet's star: own business can be started; spouses may live apart for work (not separation)

rules.name: 2nd lord in Lagna
rules.result: Strong: wealth, property and family peace in its period.

rules.name: Exalted badhaka/7th lord - dara dosha only in its dasa
rules.condition: lord_7 (also badhaka lord for dual lagnas) own/exalted, OR malefic (e.g. Rahu) in 2nd
rules.result: Marital dosha activates only during that planet's dasa (or Rahu dasa for Rahu in 2nd). If that dasa is already over or falls very late (e.g. 69+), no divorce indication.

rules.name: Rahu dasa survived
rules.condition: Rahu in 2nd but Rahu's deciding authorities (sign lord, star lord) in mutual kendra
rules.result: Couple holds together through Rahu dasa; later friction is only its residue.

guidance: Avoid predicting divorce from surface signs (malefic in 2nd, afflicted 7th lord) without checking dasa timing and deciding authorities - wrong calls cost people good matches.
open_questions_for_implementation: Badhaka lord table per lagna (movable/fixed/dual) needed for J8-07
